selection.summary: PR #1971 adds a dot option to `gh repo view .` so the README is fetched from the current branch's remote repo if available, otherwise the local README is read, with a note indicating the source (remote vs local). Relevant base evidence: view.go command logic and README rendering (h0, h2, h3, h7), http.go repository fetching and README retrieval (h1, h5, h10).
